title: Describe Data by Mean Absolute Deviation
objective: I can find the mean absolute deviation (MAD) to describe how spread out data is.
model: distances of each value from the mean on a dot plot, averaged: mean, deviations, absolute values, sum, divide by the count

widgets.component: Warm-up: mean of five numbers, share stickers, a fourth quiz for a target mean, why the mean is the balance point
widgets.root: Matches the lesson's warm-up; keys 12, 6, 90 and 'amounts above and below balance' verified.

widgets.component: Absolute deviation from a mean; MAD from deviations; lower MAD = more consistent; signed deviations cancel
widgets.root: Keys verified (4, 3, 6, Team A); the err fix (|−2| + |2| + |0| = 4, 4 ÷ 3 = 1.33) is right.

widgets.component: Deviation / absolute deviation table for 12, 8, 10, 14, 6; MAD meanings; reliable runner; divide by 4 not 3
widgets.root: Table gives 2, 2, 0, 4, 4 and MAD 2.4; runner A (MAD 1.2) vs B (5.8) with equal means; err 10 ÷ 4 = 2.5 verified.

widgets.component: Mean first; distances from the mean; full MAD
widgets.root: Sampled 120 seeds per level: L1 mean, L2 distance list / sum, L3 full MAD with the four steps in the solution; keys verified. See typography for the sign formatting.

widgets.component: Drag dots keeping the mean fixed so the MAD reaches a target
widgets.root: Conditions are mean unchanged and MAD at least X, so the student must move dots symmetrically about the mean; the live MAD readout makes distance-from-mean visible.

widgets.component: 'Each keeper's mean goals allowed per game', 'what does a smaller MAD tell you', 'which keeper should the coach start'
widgets.root: Items 1 and 3 need the two keepers' game-by-game goals (Keeper A: 1, 2, 1, 3, 2, 1; Keeper B: 0, 4, 1, 3, 0, 2) from the lesson's Connect scenario; the studio carries neither data nor figure, so 'each keeper's mean' and 'MAD 0.67' cannot be checked.
widgets.replacement: Attach two `dots` figures (Keeper A, Keeper B; min 0, max 4, label 'Goals allowed in one game') above 5.1 and 5.3 and add the coach's question to 5.3. Keys stay 'about 1.67' and 'Keeper A, smaller MAD'.

widgets.component: MAD of 4, 8, 6, 10, 2; MAD of 6, 9, 12; first step
Distances, full MAD, compare two lists, cancelled-deviation error, 73–77 vs 60–90 teams, missing distance, MAD estimate from dots, MAD 0, '7 units from a mean of 12'
widgets.root: Rechecked MAD 1.2 vs 10, 2.8 (mean 13), 3 (mean 17, distances total 18), 5, missing distance 4, dots mean 6 MAD 1, 'MAD 0 means every value equals the mean', 5 or 19.

widgets.where: Challenge §3 items 1-2 (act:dotbalance goal spread, L3-L4), item 3 (sort)
widgets.component: Fixed mean and MAD target, MAD at most X with the same range; sort sets by MAD size
widgets.root: Four-dot sets sort correctly (MAD 0 / 1 or 2 / 3 or 4); the dot levels trap moving the mean instead of the spread.
